title: Fender
html_source: They will defile Bloom’s hearth by spitting in it.

anchor.prefix: ake. They will violate the secrets of your bottom drawer. Pages will be torn from your handbook of astronomy to make them pipespills. And they will spit in your ten shilling brass
anchor.suffix:
from Hampton Leedom's. 

 BLOOM 

 Ten and six. The act of low scoundrels. Let me go. I will return. I will prove... 

1939#383

 A VOICE 

 Swear!
